images.title: Two angles at the ends
images.purpose: Show how arms from the two ends of AB at 45° and 80° meet at C.
images.composition: Base AB across the lower third; two arms rise and cross above it.
exact_structure: A horizontal teal (#0072B2) base AB labelled 5 cm, A at left, B at right.
From A an amber (#E69F00) ray going up and right at 45° to AB with a reddish purple (#CC79A7) arc labelled 45° at A.
From B an amber (#E69F00) ray going up and left at 80° to BA with a reddish purple (#CC79A7) arc labelled 80° at B.
The rays cross at exactly one point above AB, marked with a dot and the label C.
Vertices labelled A, B and C.
rejection: angles at A and B not 45° and 80°
rays that do not cross above AB
any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The point where the two arms cross is the third vertex C.
images.description: Base AB of 5 cm with arms at 45° from A and 80° from B crossing at C.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Notice the 5 cm side is part of both angles.

image_decisions.why: The included side and crossing arms are best shown in one picture.
